messages:
maria: Heads up — after the INT8 canary rollout we started seeing steady GPU memory growth on long-context traffic (>16k tokens). Repro on rtx-pool-3. attaching a tiny profiler excerpt below.

kenji: Ugh, saw a similar blip last night on staging. Was treating as noise. Can you paste the exact run command?

maria: ran with `rdw-run --model gptx-13b-int8 --longctx 20000 --profile kv`

samir: profiler snippet:
```
kv_total_slots: 184320 -> 196608  # monotonic growth across requests
kv_free_frag: 12.3% -> 5.1%
page_faults/sec: 0.3 -> 2.1
kernel_choice: matmul_v2_fallback -> matmul_accel_v1
batch_size: steady at 4
```

samir: that looks like slot fragmentation + more page faults when kernel switches to accel_v1 under certain seq len distributions. INT8 slot rounding could be creating holes.

elena: Could batching heuristics be amplifying it? If batcher groups a 20k request with small ones, kernel may pick a different path, causing different KV access patterns.

maria: My local repro: repeated single-caller requests with longctx steadily increased kv_total_slots. When I forced `--kernel matmul_accel_v1` growth stopped.

kenji: Interesting. So two interacting factors: (1) kernel selection path change causing different memory touching/paging, (2) allocator not coalescing quantized slots because sizes are misaligned after INT8 packing.

maria: Quick diff I'm testing: align int8 slot sizes to 256B and add a fast coalesce pass on free list. Patch: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4267 (WIP).

samir: can you also log `kv_alloc_align` and `slot_meta.flags`? I bet some slots end up with 0x2 (no-coalesce) because of legacy path.

maria: added those logs. sample output: `kv_alloc_align=128 -> 256`, `slot_meta.flags: 0x0,0x2,0x0,0x0` (0x2 correlates with holes).

infra-bot: Canary deploy finished for canary/rtx-pool-3 at 2078901250 :white_check_mark:

kenji: If the align fix stops growth in canary, we should backport to dedicated quick. But we need a test: create deterministic sequence that forces coalesce to run (and not rely on PR memometer).

elena: I'll add a perf test to the longctx harness that simulates 1k requests at 18-22k token lengths with mixed small tails to exercise batching edges.

samir: Also verify eval accuracy delta: INT8 + coalesce shouldn't change logits, but packing alignment might change where prefetch lands and affect timing. Run the standard quality eval (qa-suite) before/after.

maria: Ran quick qa-suite — no measurable hit in BLEU/qa-f1 within noise, but will run nightly.

kenji: Action items: (1) maria keep iterating on align+coalesce patch and watch canary; (2) elena add stress perf test; (3) samir add logs for slot flags and kernel switch trace; (4) if canary looks good after 6 hours, plan canary->stable ramp.

maria: noted. I'll post results here with timestamps. Thanks. :seedling:

samir: one more: dump `/proc/pid/pagemap` for a flagged worker when growth observed, to confirm real page faults vs accounting drift.

maria: yup will grab that and upload.

kenji: nice catch. This looks like an INT8-specific allocator/coalesce interplay with kernel-selection-induced page patterns. Good to keep batching heuristics in the loop too.

elena: tagging @perf-eng to watch the nightly run.

maria: uploaded pagemap and a flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/runs/2078901280/kv-flame.html

infra-bot: perf-harness job 2078901285 completed (longctx-harness) :rocket:

maria: last update: canary with align+coalesce ran 8h with no growth on rtx-pool-3. pushing extended canary now.

kenji: if extended holds, schedule patch for dedicated next week. Great work everyone. :tada:
